I’m in for the package, provided all five explicitly agree: 12 tons each this month, and no more than 6 each next month if the stock is 80. Otherwise, I’ll take 10 unless we agree on another whole-ton plan.

To make the trial easy to evaluate, I suggest we also specify 10 each next month if the stock is 100. If everyone follows those limits, we’ll start the following month at 100 under either recovery outcome. That gives us a two-month trial with a clean reset, rather than an open-ended commitment to 12.

Kate, do you agree? Luke, does the fallback work for you?
